_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.77 prevents a busy GUI from starving SysID's pressure measurements and acknowledgments.

In the archived LOW probe, serial parsing had 39 samples covering 0.790 seconds inside the original 0.800-second interval, but queued GUI delivery supplied SysID only ten samples covering 0.180 seconds. Replaying the original serial bytes through the new direct receiver passes the existing estimator. The incomplete scan remains rejected and is not adopted as calibration.

Both manual and retry SysID starts attach thread-safe measurement and acknowledgment receivers directly to serial input. Display updates and actuator commands retain their existing paths. Cancellation detaches the receivers; the GUI fallback cannot double-deliver samples. Fixed probe fits exclude later frames and cadence context. Probe dwell, minimum acquisition duration, pulse separation, uncertainty gates and acceptance requirements are unchanged.

Real Qt regressions include an unserviced display queue, a complete fixed-duration probe, exact response payloads, safety-event refusal, detach/restart and future-sample exclusion. Both branch release suites, layout, preset parity and mocked GUI smoke are checked. Firmware, standalone control and accepted device profiles are unchanged.

COM6 still times out before telemetry, so the independent larger-cuff repeat and installed hardware alignment remain unverified. Complete small-cuff data, matched simulator pulse baseline and real second-PC fleet adoption remain pending. This release does not qualify cross-cuff generalization or a 1,000-device rollout.
